environment: Node VM + minimal DOM + native Canvas; not a browser
passed: All 17 regions have different dimensions, authored physical outlines, distinct functional zones, reachable entrances and their original quest/object IDs. Every furniture tile belongs to its region; the 18-map world retains the beach.

The park bridge is continuously walkable across the narrowed lake; water blocks the player, while duck movement uses the actual shoreline polygon. Beach layout serialization remains exactly equivalent.
24 original, distinct, transparent CC0 regional props are placed intentionally and available offline; declared materials recolor correctly and all footprints are finite.
132 seconds of simulation in each redesigned map keep all people and animals finite and clear of scenery collisions; residents pause during player dialogue. Map changes clear active conversations.

Revision-7 scenery migrates to the new region plans, keeps custom items, allowed deletions and object properties, preserves the beach and stores a backup of the previous layout. Adventure progress remains byte-equivalent.

New props support scale, rotation, color, removal, undo and deselection in the existing editor. Native game captures and the geometric composition interpreter report connected walking areas, accessible interactions and no unresolved occlusion/overlap flags in all maps.
limitations: Actual browser CSS, touch/pointer behavior and audible audio were not verified.
Position and alpha-bound checks supplement individual visual review; they do not certify every possible user-authored layout.
